bonus.text: In November 2025, more than 100 dancers met in Windhoek for DanceSport Namibia’s nationals in Latin, Stage and Hip-Hop, judged by a South African panel. A national team was selected.
Oshituthi shomagongo, the marula fruit festival of eight Aawambo communities, joined UNESCO’s list in 2015. Guests share omagongo marula drink, then sing and dance.
Xallamo’s love of dance began with kung-fu films such as Jackie Chan’s Snake in the Eagle’s Shadow. Before Zürich, he rehearsed nine to ten hours a day.
